name: New Year's Eve at The Warehouse Project
includes: Eats Everything, Groove Armada, Oden & Fatzo, Mix-Stress
Don't F**k with Disco, Melvo Baptiste, Gina Breeze and more
Huge warehouse production across multiple rooms
blurb: Manchester's biggest NYE club night, confirmed for 2026: Defected and Glitterbox take over the vast former railway depot at Mayfield until 4am.

name: 20 Stories NYE 2026: A Midnight Masquerade
price_text: Standing £79.50; five-course dinner £200pp; premium window table £300pp
includes: Premium window tables with Laurent-Perrier champagne
blurb: A masquerade nineteen floors above Spinningfields, with one of the best skyline views in the city and an optional five-course dinner before the party.

name: Albert's Schloss NYE: Midnight in Manhattan
includes: Live bands, DJs and showtime cast
blurb: The Schloss turns into 1979 Manhattan for NYE 2026, with non-stop live entertainment from the moment you walk in until the early hours.

name: NYE at Cloud 23
price_text: £135pp; window table £175pp; VIP £250pp; dinner upgrade +£40pp (latest published packages, TBC)
includes: Table for the whole night on the 23rd floor
Midnight fizz toast and chef's midnight snacks
Optional three-course dinner at Podium first
blurb: Manchester's classic sky-high bar on the 23rd floor of the Beetham Tower, with a table all night, a DJ and a midnight toast over the city lights.

name: Via Manchester New Year's Eve
includes: Pop, dance and party anthem DJ sets
blurb: One of the Gay Village's best-known bars, billing itself as the biggest LGBTQ+ NYE party in Manchester, right on Canal Street.

name: Old Skool BINGO New Year's Eve
includes: Old Skool Bingo King or Queen crowned
blurb: Bingo, R&B classics and dance-offs in Spinningfields: a cheap, loud warm-up that finishes at 10pm, leaving time to head on for midnight.

name: Midnight Mischief at Be At One Deansgate
blurb: A wallet-friendly cocktail bar party on Deansgate with a DJ, bar bites and a glass of champagne at midnight.

name: Manchester NYE Fireworks at St Peter's Square
price_text: Free, no ticket (2024 and 2025 format; 2026 TBC)
includes: Midnight fireworks and laser show from the Central Library roof (about 8 minutes in 2025)
DJ-led countdown hosted by BBC Radio Manchester
blurb: Manchester City Council's free midnight fireworks drew more than 20,000 people across the city's squares in 2025. Plans for 2026 have not been announced yet.

name: Albert Square NYE: Ferris Wheel & Festive Fair
price_text: Free entry; Ferris wheel rides charged (2025 format; 2026 TBC)
includes: The UK's biggest mobile Ferris wheel
Street food and festive drinks stalls (alcohol on sale)
blurb: After the Christmas Markets close, Albert Square stayed open on NYE 2025 with its giant wheel, food and craft stalls until 12:30am.

name: LEGOLAND Discovery Centre New Year's Eve Party
includes: Mocktails, crowns and blowers on arrival
DJ, magic show and balloon modelling
blurb: A daytime 'midnight' for younger kids, with a DJ, magic and a balloon-drop countdown, all wrapped up by teatime.

name: Raver Tots New Year's Eve Party
venue: Escape to Freight Island, 11 Baring St
includes: Family rave with house, garage and drum & bass
Face painting and juice for kids
age: All ages (adults must come with a child)
blurb: The family rave brand brings proper club production to Freight Island for an afternoon countdown. It usually sells out in advance.

name: NYE with Our Kids Social at Kargo
includes: Silent disco with a kids' pop channel
blurb: A morning party for little ones at MediaCity: silent disco, circus skills and glitter, then home for a nap.

name: Noon Year's Eve at Albert's Schloss
includes: Live entertainment from the Haus party hosts
blurb: A daytime knees-up for early revellers: a set lunch and a party before teatime, so you can be home (or out again) by evening.

name: The Little Disco NYE at Freight Island
venue: Escape to Freight Island, 11 Baring St
price_text: Free general admission; VIP tables from £20pp (2025 prices, TBC)
includes: Manchester DJs Mix-Stress and Stu Richards (2025)
Multiple bars and street food traders
VIP tables with guaranteed entry and table service
blurb: A glittering free-entry disco in the giant food hall next to Piccadilly, with street food and a big-name DJ. Book VIP if you want guaranteed entry.

name: Hidden's End of Year Party
includes: Four rooms of UK garage, jungle and club music
2025 line-up: Pearson Sound, Riz La Teef b2b Oneman, Ghoulish and more
blurb: The underground favourite in a mill just north of the centre, with four rooms of heavyweight DJs and some of the cheapest early tickets in town.

name: NYE Bang! at Diecast
includes: Three spaces: Club Leno, Beer Hall and Old Foundry
Ten-piece live band in the Beer Hall
blurb: A former metalworks behind Piccadilly turned into a carnival for the night, with a live band, aerialists and a late warehouse room.

name: Refuge NYE: Labyrinth Masquerade Ball
venue: Refuge, Kimpton Clocktower Hotel, Oxford St
price_text: Dance from £25; Dine & Dance £100pp (2025 prices, TBC)
includes: Masquerade ball hosted by drag queens Anaphylactic and Liquorice Black
Dine & Dance: bubbles and canapés in the Winter Garden
Five-course feast with your table all evening
blurb: A theatrical masquerade in the grand Kimpton Clocktower, with drag hosts and the option of a five-course feast before the dancing.

name: Bongo's Bingo NYE: Big Fat Bingo of the Year
includes: Auld Lang Syne singalong at midnight
Food and drink packages via Rudy's
blurb: Manchester's raucous bingo rave takes over the stunning Albert Hall, a former Methodist chapel, for its annual NYE special.

name: New Year's Eve: Love is in the Air
venue: The Bridgewater Hall, Lower Mosley St
includes: The Bridgewater Hall Concert Orchestra with a live band
Pop, jazz, funk and soul hits through the ages
Pre-concert DJ and LED dancefloor in the foyer
blurb: An orchestra-to-rave concert at Manchester's concert hall, finishing in time to reach the city centre squares for midnight.

name: NYE Vivaldi Four Seasons by Candlelight
includes: Vivaldi's Four Seasons and Handel's Music for the Royal Fireworks
Cathedral lit by hundreds of candles
blurb: A calm, candlelit start to the night in the medieval cathedral, with Vivaldi and Handel's Royal Fireworks before you head out.

name: Louis Black-Tie New Year's Eve Soirée
price_text: £500pp including dinner and champagne (2025 price, TBC)
blurb: The city's most glamorous ticket: a black-tie, 1950s New York soirée with dinner, champagne and a live band in Spinningfields.

name: New Year's Eve Tasting Experience at James Martin
venue: James Martin Manchester, Great Northern Warehouse
blurb: The TV chef's restaurant inside the Great Northern serves a five-course NYE tasting menu with live entertainment.

name: New Year's Eve Gala Dinner at The Lowry Hotel
venue: The Lowry Hotel, 50 Dearmans Place, Chapel Wharf
price_text: Gala dinner + stay packages from £500 for two (2025 price, TBC)
includes: Bottle of champagne in the room
Exclusive New Year's party in The River Restaurant
blurb: A five-star riverside gala with a five-course dinner and a party, then just a lift ride to bed. Ideal if you want to skip the taxi queue.

name: Chotto Matte & Claude's Skyview Bar NYE
venue: Chotto Matte, St Michael's, 36 Jackson's Row
price_text: Claude's Skyview Bar £125pp; set menu £165pp (2025 prices, TBC)
includes: Nikkei set menu with Pommery champagne
Claude's Skyview Bar: champagne on arrival and two premium cocktails
Bottle service in the bar and lounge
blurb: Japanese-Peruvian dining at St Michael's with a high-up bar above it. Claude's Skyview Bar sold its 2025 NYE tickets on fireworks views over the city.

name: New Year's Eve at Australasia
includes: Midnight countdown at sister venue OCASA
blurb: Spinningfields' glass-pyramid basement restaurant, with an early sitting or a late one that rolls into the countdown next door.

name: Midnight Fish at Sexy Fish
price_text: Menus £95 and £130; NYE minimum spend £185pp (2025 prices, TBC)
time: All evening into the early hours
includes: Set menus or à la carte
blurb: The glossiest room in Spinningfields stages its signature end-of-year spectacle, with DJs, performers and tequila cocktails.

name: New Year's Eve at Lucky Cat
price_text: À la carte NYE menu from 6pm (2025), 20% service
includes: Asian-inspired small plates and robata grill
Perrier-Jouët champagne and sushi at midnight (2025)
blurb: Gordon Ramsay's pan-Asian spot in a former bank on King Street, with a NYE menu, DJs and champagne at midnight.

name: New Year's Eve at Bar Shrimp
price_text: Party ticket £10; dinner from £70pp (2025 prices, TBC)
includes: Several dinner sittings with all-night access
blurb: Twelve-plus hours of seafood, champagne and dancing just off Piccadilly Gardens, with a £10 party ticket if you only want the late bit.

name: NYE House Party at Nell's MediaCity
price_text: Drinks entry £5.50; non-stop pizza table £43.20 (2025 prices, TBC)
blurb: A cheap and cheerful house party at the Quays: bottomless New York-style pizza, karaoke and fizz at midnight.

name: New Year's Eve at Side Street
venue: Side Street, ABC Building, Lower Byrom St
price_text: Early bird £15; general admission £25 (2025 prices, TBC)
includes: Good Custard DJs across the rooms
Glass of prosecco with every ticket
blurb: Three connected bar spaces in the old ABC Building, with disco and house all night and a prosecco on arrival.

name: Night & Day NYE Party
includes: Soul, Motown, indie, post-punk, electro and rock
blurb: Indie classics and pop bangers until 4am at the Oldham Street institution, for the price of a pint and a bit.

name: New Year's Eve at The Blues Kitchen
includes: Three live sets from the house band
blurb: Live blues, soul and rock'n'roll on Quay Street, with a house band, bourbon and DJs until 3am.

name: NYE at MAYA
includes: Three floors: restaurant, Bar MAYA and The Pump Room
blurb: Supper, bottomless bubbles and a three-floor party on Canal Street, ending in the late-night Pump Room.

name: Dandy: New Queers Eve
includes: Alternative LGBTQ+ club night across three floors
blurb: Manchester's alternative queer club night fills all three floors of the Deaf Institute for its NYE special.

name: Midnight at Manahatta
blurb: A New York-style cocktail bar party on Deansgate that runs until 4am. All three ticket tiers sold out in 2025.

name: The Velvet Hour at The Firehouse
price_text: Standing from £25; table with prosecco and feast £70 (2025 prices, TBC)
includes: Welcome prosecco and NYE feast (table ticket)
blurb: Cabaret, drama and a sharing feast in a converted fire station on the edge of Ancoats.

name: So Fetch: 2000s New Year's Eve Party at Gorilla
includes: Railway-arch club venue by Oxford Road station
blurb: Two rooms of throwback pop under the railway arches by Oxford Road station.

name: Me Gusta Collective NYE at Band on the Wall
venue: Band on the Wall, 25 Swan St
includes: Salsa, Latin, kuduro, house, breaks and amapiano
Me Gusta Collective DJs and special guests
blurb: Global grooves and a live band at the Northern Quarter's much-loved music venue.

name: NYE at The Cut & Craft
includes: Live vocals and a DJ (Julie McKnight and Raven Mandella in 2025)
blurb: Steak, showgirls and a disco diva on Mosley Street, a few minutes' walk from St Peter's Square.

name: New Year's Eve at Bar Lina
includes: Funk, disco, soul, R&B and hip hop
blurb: A drinks-included party on Quay Street with three drinks in the ticket price and a Manchester club night on the decks.

name: NYE at Crazy Pedro's Bridge Street
blurb: The pizza party bar keeps it simple: free entry, two floors of anthems and free pizza at midnight.
